_meta.batch: NP I – Community Health Nursing, Visual Aids Patch 1
_meta.note: Adds a 'visual_aid' field (raw SVG string) to 6 existing lessons across batches 1-3. Style confirmed with Moks: clean flowchart boxes, sequence/hierarchy diagrams for concepts that are sequential/spatial/hierarchical. Legal/definitional lessons (RA 10354, RA 11166, RA 11058) intentionally excluded — a diagram there would be decorative, not clarifying. Each SVG uses viewBox='0 0 380 H' (mobile-safe width) and CSS custom-property-based classes (c-teal, c-blue, c-amber, c-coral, c-pink, c-purple, c-gray) that auto-adapt to the app's light/dark theme. If the live app doesn't already define these class names/CSS variables, Code will need to add them to the global stylesheet (see integration notes at the bottom) or swap to hardcoded hex matching the app's existing palette.

integration_notes: These SVGs use classes (node, c-teal, c-blue, c-amber, c-coral, c-pink, c-purple, c-gray, th, ts, arr) and CSS custom properties (--surface-1, --border-strong, color ramp variables) from Anthropic's internal Visualizer design system — the live app almost certainly does NOT have these defined yet.

Code has two options: (1) Add a small CSS block defining these class names using the app's OWN existing palette (map c-teal/c-blue/c-amber/c-coral/c-pink/c-purple to the app's Sage/Sky/existing accent colors, or introduce new ones consistent with the girly/pastel design system already implemented), or (2) do a find-and-replace pass converting the class-based colors to the app's actual hardcoded hex values before storing these SVGs. Option 1 is less work and keeps future diagrams consistent by just reusing the same classes.

Recommended: reskin using the ALREADY-APPROVED app palette from the Claude Design handoff (cream #FBF7F2, ink #453A50, lavender #8B72D8, blush #E36B8D, coral #E8875F, sage #6FA86B, sky #5E93BE) rather than introducing a second unrelated color system just for diagrams.
Render each visual_aid as raw SVG inside the lesson detail view, positioned after the lesson's core_content / detailed_explanation section.
All 6 SVGs are viewBox='0 0 380 H' — already sized for the 375px mobile-first constraint from the original design brief; verify rendering at that width in the real app shell, not just this preview.
